Callout.Name: Public Intoxication
Callout.Message: Person asleep in a doorway, very drunk.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect, no injuries seen, businesses complaining.

Script.Line: I am asleep. I was not bothering anybody.
I have got nowhere to go. That is why I am in the doorway.
I will move. Just let me get my things together.

Lines.Approach: They are asleep in the doorway and they smell like a brewery. Do not let them sleep it off in this weather.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
